knowline-35b-a3b-gen1.5-nvfp4.notes: NVIDIA's MIXED_PRECISION recipe (experts and shared experts NVFP4 W4A16, attention and GDN projections FP8); lm_head kept BF16 for the score head's FP32 option logits; input_scale copied from the reference. Template: knowline-gen1.5. Serve with --lm-head-dtype bf16.

d3-ultra-nvfp4.format_reference: a2genesis/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 (ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION: MLP NVFP4 W4A16, attention/GDN projections FP8)

published.note: the output of install/convert.sh, byte-identical (install/d3-ultra-nvfp4.sha256); install/fetch.sh downloads it

d3-ultra-nvfp4.notes: Qwen3.8-27B decision model. lm_head synthesized as BF16: d3's FP32 readout rows (cast to BF16) at the code token ids, zeros elsewhere; serve with --lm-head-dtype bf16. Needs Atlas prefix_bidir (/v1/score "attention": "prefix_bidir"); template d3-ultra. FP8 input_scale copied from the reference (calibrated on base Qwen3.8).

serve.lowp_note: W4A4 (NVFP4 weights x NVFP4 tokens) for the MLP and attention, W8A8 for the GDN projections. ./start.sh --precision w4a8 (LOWP=1) is the W4A8 alternative (results/2026-11-07-d3-ultra-w4a4)
serve.packs_note: --score-packs 8: up to 8 knowledge packs held (knowledge / knowledge_name in /v1/systemone); each holds one SSM slot while held. PACKS=0 ./start.sh turns them off (results/2026-11-08-knowledge-packs)
serve.temperature_fit: tools.sparkscore.calibrate fitted on kev decision-v4 (clean rows) only, on the W4A8 build; the reported kev suites and JevBench are held out, and the W4A4 build keeps them (kev transfer-v4 NLL 0.334 on both)
